request: Analyze GSE221003 for PMID 36611902 (Nicotinamide Mononucleotide Administration Prevents Doxorubicin-Induced Cardiotoxicity and Loss in Physical Activity in Mice.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (poly(A), NovaSeq 6000, STAR + featureCounts) of mouse heart
final.primary_estimand: Effect of doxorubicin vs vehicle, and of NMN on top of doxorubicin, on heart gene expression (acute regimen, D5). No exercise intervention: the only exercise-related measure is a treadmill exhaustion TEST (S2.5.p1, S3.7.p1) used as a phenotypic outcome in chronic cohort-2; RNA-seq hearts come from acute cohort-1 and chronic cohort-3 (S2.2.p2, S2.2.p4).
final.sample_inclusion: Acute: 13-14 hearts per group of cohort-1 (S2.2.p2)
planned_contrasts: Acute Doxo vs Ctrl (S3.3.p1; paper: 3874 DEGs)
Acute Doxo-NMN vs Doxo (S3.3.p1; paper: 2207 DEGs)
final.paper_method: edgeR 3.32.1, TMM, estimateDisp, glmQLFit + QL F-test (S2.9.p1)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.2.p1-p4 and S2.9.p1 define the RNA-seq design: heart tissue from Ctrl, Doxo, Doxo-NMN mice in an acute (cohort-1) and a chronic (cohort-3) study. Exercise appears only as a treadmill exhaustion test outcome (S2.5.p1, S3.7.p1) on chronic cohort-2, which has no RNA-seq. No group trains or exercises as an intervention. Acute threshold: adjusted p < 0.05 and FC 1.5 (S3.3.p1).

checks: GEO titles: acute study mouse heart control/doxo/doxo+NMN; 14/13/13 samples match 13-14 per group (S2.2.p2)
data_processing: STAR + featureCounts count table Acute_Doxo_Heart.csv

ownership.reasoning: Data availability S11.p1 cites GSE221003; acute matrix holds 40 heart samples matching acute cohort-1 RNA-seq.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns X<n>_counts carry the heart number that the GEO description stores as ',Heart_<n>'; exact match on that number. Chronic-study GSMs are absent from this matrix and stay unmatched.

matrix.reasoning: integer_fraction 1.0, max 4.2e6; GEO data_processing: featureCounts count table; paper used edgeR on counts (S2.9.p1).

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast: the sequenced hearts are Ctrl (vehicle), Doxo and Doxo-NMN only (S2.2.p2, S3.3.p1). Exercise appears only as a treadmill exhaustion test outcome in a non-sequenced chronic cohort (S2.5.p1, S3.7.p1). An exercise effect on gene expression is not identifiable from these data.
design.reasoning: The request asks for an exercise effect. No sample group differs by exercise or training; treatment levels are Vehicle/Doxo/Doxo-NMN only. Running a drug contrast would not answer the question.

discrepancies.paper: treadmill exhaustion test as a functional outcome in chronic cohort-2 (S2.5.p1)
discrepancies.data: no exercise factor in GEO; RNA-seq from acute cohort-1 and chronic cohort-3

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq of mouse heart, chronic regimen (day 60)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of chronic doxorubicin vs PBS, and of oral NMN on top of doxorubicin, on heart gene expression. No exercise intervention (treadmill only a test on cohort-2, S2.5.p1; RNA-seq on cohort-3, S2.2.p4).
planned_contrasts: Chronic Doxo vs Ctrl (S3.6.p1; paper: 9 DEGs)
Chronic Doxo-NMN vs Doxo (S3.6.p1; paper: 0 DEGs)

checks: 17 chronic heart samples (5/6/6) match 5-6 per group of cohort-3 (S2.2.p4)

ownership.reasoning: Chronic matrix matches the GEO chronic-study GSMs.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns such as CTRL.17.Heart equal the GEO description suffix CTRL-17-Heart up to separators; normalize_keys matches ignoring -/.
